name: swift-node-monorepo
description: Node-API bridge for Swift. Write native Node addons in Swift without C++ glue.

scripts.build:core: pnpm --filter swift-node build && pnpm --filter swift-node-unplugin build
scripts.build:example:secure-storage: pnpm --dir examples/secure-storage build && pnpm --dir examples/secure-storage-consumer-esm build
scripts.build:examples: pnpm build:example:hello-world && pnpm build:example:hello-world-tsdown && pnpm build:example:secure-storage && pnpm build:example:timer-callback
scripts.precommit: pnpm build:core && pnpm --dir examples/timer-callback build && pnpm --dir examples/timer-callback test
